identity: A color picker has controls for changing the selected color, a readout of that color, and a goal shown as a swatch, color code, name, preset, or picture.

scenarios.name: swatch
scenarios.screen: A goal color swatch sits on a labeled card beside the picker. The picker shows a saturation and brightness square, a hue strip, a current color swatch, and a selected color readout; its starting color differs from the goal.
never: A picture with a marked region.
A tray of named preset colors.

arrangements.text: The picker sits left of the goal card, with a vertical hue strip beside the color square and the current color below it.
The goal card sits above a color wheel; a value strip runs beside the wheel and the current color sits below.
The goal card sits left of three horizontal red, green, and blue sliders, with the current color below the sliders.

scenarios.hint: Show a solid leaf-green Target swatch and a clearly different purple Current swatch. Picker hue thumb, SV plane and SV marker must agree with purple Current. No gradients, shading or texture in either swatch; numerical readouts are display-only.

scenarios.name: hex
scenarios.screen: A goal card shows the target color code and its swatch. The picker shows a saturation and brightness square, a hue strip, a current color swatch, and a selected color readout; the current color differs from the target code.
never: A picture used as the color target.
A tray of named preset colors.

arrangements.text: The picker sits left of the goal card, with a vertical hue strip beside the color square and the color readout below.
The goal card sits above a color wheel and its adjacent value strip, with the color readout below the wheel.
The goal card sits beside three horizontal hue, saturation, and lightness sliders, with the color readout below them.

scenarios.hint: Show the exact requested target hex code as a non-editable label. Current swatch and visible hue/SV controls consistently show a different starting color. All numeric values are read-only; no keyboard path.

scenarios.name: named
scenarios.screen: The target is a written color name. The picker shows a saturation and brightness square, a hue strip, a current color swatch, and a selected color readout; its starting color is different from the named color.
never: A card displaying the target as a color code.
A tray of named preset swatches.
A picture with a color sampling pin.

arrangements.text: The color square sits left of a vertical hue strip, with the current color and its readout below.
A color wheel sits left of a value strip, with the current color and its readout beneath the wheel.
A saturation and lightness square sits above a horizontal hue strip, with the current color and its readout below.

scenarios.name: palette
scenarios.screen: A short tray of labeled preset swatches sits beside the picker, and a goal card shows the target swatch. The picker shows a saturation and brightness square, a hue strip, and the current color; no preset is selected at the normal start.
never: A preset already selected at the normal start.
A picture used as the color target.

arrangements.text: The picker sits left of the goal card, with the preset swatches in a row below both.
The preset swatches form a column beside a color wheel; the goal card sits above the wheel and its value strip.
The goal card sits above three horizontal red, green, and blue sliders, with the preset swatches in a row beneath them.

scenarios.name: image
scenarios.screen: An illustration contains the region whose color is the target. Beside it, the picker shows a saturation and brightness square, a hue strip, a current color swatch, and a selected color readout; an eyedropper button is idle.
never: An eyedropper already armed at the normal start.
A tray of named preset colors.

arrangements.text: The illustration sits left of the picker, with the eyedropper button beside the color square and a vertical hue strip on its other side.
The illustration sits above a color wheel, with the eyedropper button and value strip beside the wheel.
The illustration sits left of three horizontal red, green, and blue sliders, with the eyedropper button above the sliders.

scenarios.name: hex-typed
scenarios.screen: A goal card shows the target color code and its swatch. The picker has an editable hex field containing the current color, alongside a saturation and brightness square and a hue strip; the current color differs from the target.
never: An empty color entry field at the normal start.
A picture used as the color target.
A tray of named preset colors.

arrangements.text: The picker sits left of the goal card, with a vertical hue strip beside the color square and the hex field below.
The goal card sits above a color wheel and adjacent value strip, with the hex field below the wheel.
The goal card sits left of three horizontal red, green, and blue sliders, with the editable color fields below the sliders.
